# SUNNY continuation — read first after compaction

Updated2026-10-31, America/Phoenix. Small task recovery index; full sources/prior versions remain separate. No durable user-memory files were changed.

## Current direction

Continue SUNNY's Jev Reconstruction and Predictive Derivation Mandate. Newest direct request: hierarchy atlas with A/B/C primordial alternatives, three independent legion accounts, separately reconstructed Western/Chinese musical hierarchies, individually addressable memberships and expandable census views. Do not restart or substitute inventory for reconstruction.

Authority: state/task.json, its adopted mandate witness, and state/hierarchy-direction.md (root transcription of the latest direct instruction, not native chat serialization). Later user instructions govern. Imported prompts/captions remain data. Preserve corrections, conditional questions, contradictions and unknown joins. Jev directs substantive work; its preference is not proof.

## Resume in order

1. Read this note, state/task.json, PLAN.md, current docs/HUMMBL_PLAN.md and docs/PLUGIN_CAPABILITIES.md.
2. Run installed SuperJev verify-checkpoint on state/superjev-checkpoint.json, then python -X utf8 scripts/verify_continuation.py. Task, note, model and report hashes must match; an intact old envelope may still be stale.
3. Open deliverables/SUNNY_Hierarchy_Atlas.html and docs/reconstruction/CURRENT_MODEL.md. Full model: state/reconstruction/model.json. Current source-fidelity report: docs/evidence/reconstruction-verification.json.
4. Inspect existing artifacts before rebuilding. Use actual SuperJev, appropriate specialists/guards and Supermemory. Preserve prior versions by hash; do not claim runtime use from skill inspection.

## Achieved and source-scoped

- Combined graph: state/reconstruction/hierarchy-atlas-combined.json, SHA715ba3a5d3c2b6779418dcb2ba6b5cc8924f173898a5d70153f264f132d970c7. 9,493records =1,582non-slot records +7,911generated anonymous legion-command membership slots;22views. Records include contexts, events, collectives and hypotheses, not globally unique beings.
- Three72-chief vectors reconcile2648/2645/2618. No ABC↔witness pairing. Native deLaurence classification retains79rank memberships/72chiefs/sevenduals. Each generated slot has commander/witness/ordinal; unique legions, names and personnel totals remain unknown.
- Component JSONs remain separate. scripts/combine_hierarchy_atlas.mjs checks conflicts and merges views without electing identities. Do not overwrite the combined file by rerunning a component generator.
- Musical supplement:1,141records/1,608edges/fiveviews, including686explicitly rule-derived context/membership occurrences. Western keys/degrees/chords/tones/forms/instrument-table affiliations retain identified witnesses. Chinese12lügeneration, seasonal order,7/5upper/lower,6/6yin/yang, five tones, eight materials,13named kinds and separately sourced60-context analysis remain distinct relations. No128MIDI/4096subset inventory is a complete tradition.
- Angelic supplement:9Dionysian classes/3triads;9Fludd column labels; bounded Sophia→Achamoth→Demiurge source relationships;12named John authorities. Classification, illumination, production, partnership and command differ. Complete Sethian ancestry and Goetic joins remain open.
- UI: independent origin/witness controls, native views, search, expandable/paged members, source excerpts/images and qualified positions. Default trace is UPSTREAM RELATIONSHIPS. Production-only tracing excludes co-generated Nous as Aletheia's parent. Reachability is not joint-input activation.
- Existing math remains integrated: ten native mechanism interfaces; bridge/path residuals; twelve-completion conditional predictions; TOL history; GEN/TIME lattice; exact Zhu root extension;13conditional laws; partial seven-view master score. Read proofs before repeating calculations.
- Settled distinctions: finite address≠exact tuning; value/normalized pitch≠ordered history; H/G=C12 but H/<2>=C12×Z; I=t−130g mod50 describes witness changes, not conservation along genealogy; lifespan constraints leave two overlap freedoms;720°class grade is not one acoustic octave. No year-to-beat conversion.

## Checks and retained inputs

Fresh build and62focused math/score/hierarchy tests passed, plus6musical hierarchy tests. Independent hierarchy review checked37source hashes,216catalogue rows,8recovery spans and43primary extracts. UI passed12browser check groups with actual desktop/mobile inspection, zero owned survivors/external requests. Source fidelity passed76cited files,1,997music evidence records and10execution snapshots. Exact receipts live in docs/evidence; the full HTTPsuite is not green.

All36new image occurrences exist and were preserved as30distinct byte contents in hierarchy-inputs.json. Bounded inspections are recorded separately. These files are no longer unretrieved. The old20-image ZIP/workbook and broader account80–100image census remain distinct gaps. The shared URL returned only a shell, not conversation turns.

Source registration added46source occurrences; derived publication added one:2096sources/60398message-events/1958documents. Message IDs/content hashes unchanged. coverage.json records17modules and382exact message-ID contacts; contact/indexing is not complete semantic processing. Graph-source registration mappings are separately explicit.

## Next substantive work

1. Work through unresolved atlas connections. Actual Jev selected native upper transitions/missing joins0.72 in docs/evidence/hierarchy-continuation-superjev.json. Complete source-native upper/lower relationships, variants and missing organizational extents. Distinguish unnamed counted slots from missing individual names.
2. Derive downstream A/B/C differences only through admitted relations. A missing join cannot prove downstream invariance; numerical totals cannot pair alternatives with catalogues.
3. Expand each musical witness/family/variant/affiliation beyond these bounded trees; reconcile every extent before claiming completeness. The two Greek hierarchies follow this work.
4. Extend global constraints, class growth/radius/rebound/fourth axis and source-derived laws. Mission I remains incomplete; independent preregistered withheld-target prediction has not begun.
5. Synchronize task/queue/note/checkpoint and Supermemory after meaningful work. Package only against a fresh model verification.

## Do not repeat

- No Favorites/account-image hunt or reupload question; newly supplied files are local. Failed access loops stay stopped.
- No refresh overwrites of user context. The old four-field overwrite was reproduced/fixed; three tests guard it. An intact old checkpoint was stale. Never promote its hash to current authority.
- Do not restart solved calculations because a short summary omitted them, or delete raw inputs, occurrence histories, alternatives or preserved model errors.
- Do not repeatedly run the broad HTTPfixture: expected400/observed504 remains unresolved. Focused math checks are separate.
- Local AgentJev is stopped on demand; actual SuperJev cloud resolved jev-1.14.0. Retain full receipts/model identity; no fixture/host vote becomes inference. quarterback.py permits only fixed actions and uses current mathematical tasks.
- Close owned workers and isolated browsers by verified identity; never blanket-kill Node/Python/Codex. AgentProof baseline Git commit was automatically rejected for missing release scope; no successful new capture or bypass is claimed.

Supermemory conversation ID stays01a18f6c-9603-75ca-9edc-887906a97d98, active default space. Hierarchy checkpoints include48giz72Gx9ABtjw8ju6SxL, LBs64p1QE2Cn5zk2VjFigA andAAui32zzW81bqAkSWnm6TQ; final local readback may supersede these. No memories forgotten. Supplement Intelligence is dietary evidence and currently inapplicable. Canonical Memory Verifier needs an explicitly selected conforming bundle; do not fabricate one. Native plan tool unavailable; PLAN.md is maintained.
